companyPageUniverse.name: Licensed property and casualty insurers
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: Every source-verified risk-bearing insurer authorized in a launch jurisdiction, including distinct subsidiaries when the regulator treats them as distinct entities.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Identity, official channels, public regulatory records, filed forms, and sourced coverage relationships. Never a reputation verdict.

companyPageUniverse.name: Licensed life and annuity insurers
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: Every source-verified life or annuity risk-bearing entity in the selected jurisdiction.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Identity, official channels, public regulatory records, product-form sources, and jurisdiction context.

companyPageUniverse.name: Licensed health insurers and HMOs
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: Every source-verified health insurer or HMO listed by the relevant regulator.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Identity and official consumer/regulatory information; do not summarize individualized benefits or medical coverage.

companyPageUniverse.name: Surplus lines and nonadmitted insurers
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: Entities in an official eligible or approved surplus-lines list for the selected jurisdiction.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Identity, market role, official list status, and public source records. Never imply availability for a risk.

companyPageUniverse.name: Residual markets, pools, and facilities
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: State-created or state-recognized facilities such as FAIR plans, wind pools, earthquake authorities, and assigned-risk plans.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Program identity, eligibility-source links, forms, public notices, and limits of the program record.

companyPageUniverse.name: Insurance guaranty associations
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: Official state guaranty associations and their public coverage or receivership materials.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Public program reference only; do not present a guaranty association as an insurer or financial-strength score.

companyPageUniverse.name: MGAs, program administrators, and wholesalers
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: Organizations with a source-verified role in placing, administering, or distributing insurance, separated from the risk-bearing carrier.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Role and identity record; show the actual insurer when the source names it.

companyPageUniverse.name: Claims administrators and TPAs
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: Source-verified administrators that consumers may encounter in a claim or benefit process.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Identity and role context; never confuse an administrator with the insurer or promise a claims outcome.

companyPageUniverse.name: Reinsurers and industry entities
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: Publicly sourceable entities relevant to industry research, clearly labeled as consumer-facing or industry-facing.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Industry reference pages, not consumer recommendations.

companyPageUniverse.name: Regulators and public insurance entities
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: NAIC, state insurance departments, public authorities, residual programs, and official complaint or filing portals.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Authority/source pages that help readers verify licensing, filings, notices, and public programs.

companyPageUniverse.name: Brokers, agents, and financial professionals
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: Only opted-in profiles with identity, role, jurisdiction, and credential verification appropriate to the proposed contribution.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Contributor profile, not an insurer dossier and not an endorsement.

companyPageUniverse.name: InsurTech and distribution companies
companyPageUniverse.inclusion: Publicly sourceable companies that distribute, administer, or provide technology around insurance, with the role explicitly named.
companyPageUniverse.pageRole: Technology or distribution context; preserve the distinction from a risk-bearing insurer.

sourceSystems.name: NAIC Consumer Insurance Search
sourceSystems.role: company identity and consumer-facing regulator search

sourceSystems.name: NAIC Financial Data Repository
sourceSystems.role: publicly appropriate financial/regulatory source intake when access and licensing permit

sourceSystems.name: State insurance department company records
sourceSystems.role: license status, company lists, complaints, enforcement, rate/form filings, and market conduct records

sourceSystems.name: Official company sources
sourceSystems.role: legal name, official domain, public forms, notices, and consumer channels; always captured with retrieval date

publicationRule: No candidate becomes a public page until it has source records, a drafted answer, resolved citations, appropriate jurisdiction scope, and licensed review.
